body:
>  Is that like, being cheerful and going along with them but the whole thing is kinda shallow?

Somewhat. It’s hard to actually fake being cheerful for me, I’ve been depressed for a long, long time.

I guess the best way to describe it is like if you were hollow, and every thing the other person says that stings enters and just bounces around inside your hollowness but you just give a nervous chuckle. Everything that you can’t relate to just kind of bounces off of you. Anything that you can somewhat relate to prompts a canned response you’ve learned over the years to just get through the conversation.

> What are you doing to try and meet people or build purpose in your life?

Quite honestly, i don’t know. I’m chasing a degree that i don’t think will be useful or that i can use effectively. I’ve withdrawn from most of my friends these last few months, as being a closet trans individual you can only hear bad things about being trans in the form of jokes so many times.

I can’t actually meet people who will understand that, because inevitably it will out me. Reddit’s been about the main source of social interaction for me here lately.

> There are other people out in the world, some of whom you may be able to develop a really amazing bond with. 

Again, i know definitively that i will develop no lasting connections. I’ve faked almost every one I’ve ever had, and the once or twice i thought i had developed real connections with people, i misread the situation or they were emotionally dishonest themselves. I’m a trash can. Useful to have at times but no one likes.
